refresh.description: The button that fetches the table's rows again.

columns.description: The button that opens the column manager, and the heading of its one group.

actions.description: The button on a row that opens its actions.

empty.description: Shown in place of the rows when the table holds none.

clear.description: The button that clears the selected rows.

searchColumns.description: The placeholder of the column manager's search.

search.description: The placeholder of the table's search.

text.description: The label of the search's text literal: the option that opens the quote and takes free text, leading the field panel.
